run_note: Controlled manual pilot of the independent Tools & Guides editorial workflow, outside the Tuesday/Friday scheduler. Existing first RAG application tutorial is on main as a draft; selected a distinct evidence-based retrieval-evaluation learning outcome. The candidate guide remains unpublished; live model integration and cover-illustration provenance not yet verified.

candidates.title: Evaluate RAG Retrieval Quality with a Golden Question Set
candidates.reader_outcome: Create a small labeled query set and measure Recall@k and MRR@k with code that reports individual retrieval misses.
candidates.reason: Distinct from an introductory RAG deployment tutorial: this teaches deterministic measurement of retrieval coverage and ranking quality using a synthetic corpus and no paid model API.

candidates.title: Deploying Your First RAG Application
candidates.reader_outcome: Build and start a local RAG API using FastAPI, Ollama, and runbook documents.
candidates.reason: The same reader outcome already exists in src/content/guides/first-rag-application.md, merged from PR #189 and still status: draft. Do not recreate it.

candidates.title: Checking whether generated RAG claims are supported
candidates.reader_outcome: Verify that a generated answer's individual claims are supported by retrieved passages.
candidates.reason: A claim-level scoring tutorial would require a reviewed support-judgment dataset and an explicitly defined evaluation protocol. Distinct from checking reference IDs or retrieval overlap; defer until such evidence can be assembled.
